_doc: HCAI SB 1953 seismic compliance data for CA hospital muni obligors. Building-level data from HCAI Seismic Ratings & Collapse Probabilities dataset (CHHS Open Data Portal), refreshed 2026-05-14. Extension data from HCAI Seismic Deadline Extensions Granted dataset (CHHS), refreshed 2026-05-14.
_methodology: Buildings filtered to status='OSHPD 1-In Service' (active GAC inpatient). SPC < 4 = SPC 1/1s/2/2s (non-compliant by 2030). SPC-2 buildings need retrofit or closure by 2030-01-01. Extensions counted across SB 90/SB 306/SB 499/AB 523/SB 1661/AB 2190 categories.
_caveats: HCAI maintains facility/building-level data; obligor mapping is manually curated. Stanford figures include both Stanford Hospital (new tower opened 2019, SPC 5) plus older buildings. UC system aggregates UCLA/UCSF/UCSD/UCI/UCD acute care campuses only. Retrofit cost estimates are best-effort from public disclosures.
